title: Initial Build Offer · Mile High Royal Lions ↔ Lightskin Legends

analysis.executiveSummary: Mile High Royal Lions leverages wide receiver bench depth in Marvin Harrison (age 24.0, 63.9 C-AVI) and Pat Bryant (age 23.0, 57.8 C-AVI) to target DK Metcalf (age 28.0, 74.3 C-AVI) from Lightskin Legends. In a 16-team full PPR league, converting non-starting bench pieces into an established weekly FLEX starter directly enhances Mile High's 'Win Championship' window. For Lightskin Legends (Playoff Push), this offer provides two young wideouts to reset their receiving age profile while adding depth, creating a realistic win-win trade path.

Commanded a ~25% target share early in 2026, preserving high weekly fantasy volume despite efficiency variance.
